Set up

Set up your plan

Takes a minute. You can change any of this later under Settings.

How the week runs

Day 1 is Strength A, then steady bike, Strength B, bike intervals, Strength A again, an easy ride or walk, and a rest day. The week starts on whatever date you pick, so day 1 doesn't have to be a Monday.

What gets saved

Everything stays on this device in the browser: your settings, ticked sets and weigh-ins. Nothing is sent anywhere. Clearing the browser data resets it.

Reset

Wipe ticked sets and weigh-ins but keep your settings.

Plan

The week

Diet side of the deficit

Training covers roughly 300 kcal a day averaged over the week. Eat about 250 kcal a day less than you do now and aim for 140 to 170 g of protein so the weight you lose is fat, not muscle.

Saturday walking test

Pass all three before swapping the bike for a walk: 15 single-leg calf raises on the left with pain 2/10 or less; 30 seconds on the left leg, hands off; no limp. Flat ground only, start at 30 minutes.

Week 2 and beyond

Strength: top of the rep range on every set with three or more reps left, go up a step. Bike: add a level to the steady ride every one to two weeks; intervals back to level 9 around weeks 3 to 4 if the ankle is fine. Ankle: reverse lunges and low step-ups around week 6 to 7 after the sprain if the walking test is easy. Shoulder: incline push-ups from week 3 if there is no apprehension; behind-the-neck work and dips stay out for good.

Bike

Bike levels

ZoneLevelTalk test
Easy2 to 3Full conversation
Easy-moderate3 to 4Chatting, slightly puffed
Steady4 to 5Short sentences
Hard7 to 8A few words
Max, not this week9 and upCan't talk

If level 5 lets you chat freely, go up one. If level 4 leaves you gasping, go down one. If the screen shows watts, steady is about 140 to 160 W. Ankle aching: drop a level or two and spin faster.

Steady ride

5 min at level 2 to 3, 30 min at level 4 to 5, 5 min at level 2 to 3.

Intervals

5 min at level 3, then 6 rounds of 2 min hard and 2 min at level 3, then 6 min at level 2.

Easy ride

45 min at level 3 to 4, or a flat walk if you pass the ankle test.

Pain rules

Pain rules

Use these every session

0 to 3 out of 10

Keep going, as long as it settles back to normal by the next morning.

4 to 5

Reduce weight, range or reps for that exercise. Still 4 or more, swap it for an alternative.

6 or more, or worse next morning

Stop that exercise. Rest the area 48 hours and restart a level lower.

Stop and see your physio, GP or surgeon

Shoulder: a feeling the joint is shifting or about to slip, a painful clunk, new pins and needles or numbness down the arm, or new night pain.

Ankle: swelling that increases week to week, the ankle giving way, pain pressing on the bony tip of the outer ankle bone or the outer edge of the midfoot, or still limping at four to five weeks.

First-set rule for weights

Hit the reps with five or more left in you: go up a step (2.5 to 5 kg on machines, 2 kg on dumbbells). Three or four left: correct. Form breaks or you can't reach the low number: drop a step. Anything using the left arm, the left shoulder sets the weight.
